profile.headline: Software Engineer at Netflix
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 14 years of experience building and scaling enterprise-scale distributed systems.
Founding engineer of the LinkedIn Business Manager platform, a 0->1 initiative that now influences ~80% of LinkedIn Ads revenue. Currently focused on the feed recommendation stack, building large-scale data pipelines and ranking infrastructure to optimize content delivery.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Part of Ads Account Foundation Team

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Working on the feed recommendation and ranking systems.
- Building foundations for ingesting interactions from feed & data dependency management platform

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Managing a team of 10+ eng for LinkedIn Business Manager. Driving the roadmap and supporting the team to build various features to simplify the marketing experience on LinkedIn through Business Manager.

https://business.linkedin.com/marketing-solutions/business-manager

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
LinkedIn Business Manager is a managerial platform that makes it easier for organizations to manage their Campaign Manager Ad accounts and LinkedIn Pages from one place. Agencies and large advertisers can use Business Manager to save time on administrative tasks to focus on what matters most - drive positive outcomes for their clients and businesses. https://www.linkedin.com/products/linkedin-business-manager/

• Successfully built and launched all Alpha, Beta 1, Beta 2, and Beta GA milestones from ground up. 
• Implemented a lot of foundation work for the product (eg. authentication layer for the product, initial authorization logic, setting up the codebase and the structure, etc) while delivering features like audience sharing and many more. As the team grew, acted as a tech lead overseeing all of the projects from the team. 
• Managed data modeling committee for the frontend API to keep the data modeling quality high and consistent for the product. 
• As the team grew to a point where the Business Manager was split into multiple sub teams, ran a weekly meeting (close to 2 years) with all the backend engineers to keep everyone in sync and drive technical discussions and alignments. At its peak, there were 30+ eng working on the product.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Business Manager (Feb 2019 ~ Sep 2020)
• One of the founding members of the Business Manager team, building the product from ground up. 
• Successfully launched the Alpha version of the product in Summer 2020, which enabled claiming advertising account in LinkedIn Campaign Manager and sharing of Matched Audiences across advertising accounts. 
• Implemented a proof-of-concept project for enabling SSO Login for LinkedIn Campaign Manager.

Enterprise Platform (Apr 2017 ~ Feb 2019) 
• Team was responsible for Enterprise License Provisioning & Management for LinkedIn Enterprise Products. 
• Helped build a new robust pipeline for Provisioning LinkedIn Enterprise products & solutions to manage License lifecycle for LinkedIn Enterprise products 
• Implemented a feature to provision a bundle product with hierarchy.
• Helped build a new Support Portal for LinkedIn Enterprise products, that enables self-service across the organization while onboarding new enterprise customers. Enabled placing pre-orders for Enterprise Products. 
• Helped migrate LinkedIn Learning to the new provisioning system. 
• Designed a migration plan for LinkedIn Sales Navigator product to onboard.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Key contributor of re-writing backend of Legacy Demand Manager to a new service which is one of the core components of the platform. Led the project from beginning to the end, including design, documentation,  and implementation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Contributed to writing in-house scheduler integrated with AWS ECS to schedule Docker jobs. 
• Built a microservice responsible for third party social channel integration such as of Google AdWords and BingAds. 
• Contributed to refactoring and implementing new features for existing analytics data pipeline, which involved updating map reduce jobs to capture new definition of visits and conversions, writing test cases, and enforcing data consistency throughout the pipeline.

positions.title: Edison Engineering Development Program Engineer
positions.description:
Third rotation: Proficy Knowledge Center (San Ramon, CA)	Jan. 2014 – July 2014
Proficy Knowledge Center (PKC) asset management software provides intelligent fleet management by allowing operational visibility into your fleet of assets over a standard Internet connection.

Second rotation: Proficy Historian HD (Foxboro, MA) 		          May 2013 – December 2013
Proficy Historian HD is the time-series database built on Apache Hadoop providing the advanced Big Data management capabilities upon which the analytic and visual capabilities are built.  

First rotation: Cyber Security (Foxboro, MA)      	August 2012 – April 2013

company.name: Boston University, Metropolitan College & Extended Education

positions.title: Researcher – Computer Science Dept. Image and Video Computing Group with Professor Margrit Betke
positions.description:
• Improved program structure and stability of CustomizableKeyboard, a customizable on-screen keyboard for people with disability, added a set of UI, and conducted user studies with different keyboard designs.
• Conducted user studies and improved software from feedback.

publications.title: Click Control: Improving Mouse Interaction for People with Motor Impairments
publications.publisher: Published in ASSETS 2011(Int. ACM SIGACCESS Conf. on Computers and Accessibility). · Sep 28, 2011
